title: Stationary desktop terrain continuously rebuilds and evicts visible chunks
reproduction: Open a fresh guest session at 1440x900
Leave the camera stationary and sample world cache counters five seconds apart
Inspect surface-ground tiles drawn per frame; repeat at base zoom .7
expected: Visible ground is reused from a bounded cache; stationary frames do not rebuild/evict the same chunks.
actual: Legacy world rebuilt/evicted 972 chunks in five seconds at default desktop zoom; surface ground rebuilt 7680 tiles per frame with a full 16-slot cache.

research.summary: Reproduced terrain cache thrashing. Candidate eliminates measured idle rebuilds; broader validation is pending.

known_facts.statement: Default desktop working set exceeds the old cache capacities and triggers continuous rebuilds while stationary.
After the candidate, idle builds/evictions are zero at default and .7 zoom on desktop and iPhone Chromium.

unknowns.question: Does the correction eliminate the originally reported freeze on physical iPhone?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Desktop cache thrashing alone does not reproduce every iOS crash.
unknowns.quickest_test: Deploy verified candidate and repeat real iPhone play and World Editor reopening.

change.summary: Skip uninitialized legacy terrain; use actual camera view and bounded device budgets for surface LRU.

validation.method: Five-second idle metrics at two zooms; boot move8s/rest10s/resume4s across three browser projects

attempt_history.conclusion: Idle rebuild loop eliminated in measured local cases and three boot cycles passed. Full matrix and physical iPhone remain pending.

next_best_actions.action: Complete feature/zoom matrix, inspect visuals and resources, then verify deployed and physical iPhone behavior
next_best_actions.reason: Prevent accepting one isolated local result as a global fix
next_best_actions.expected_signal: No continuous terrain rebuilding, no crashes, movement resumes after rest
next_best_actions.stop_condition: Any regression requires owner-level diagnosis before certification

fix.summary: Bounded working-set cache and suppression of uninitialized legacy terrain.

notes: Local evidence does not close the physical iPhone World Editor report.
